**Upcoming webtoon on 21st June**

[Original novel](https://ridibooks.com/books/4629003866?_s=instant&_q=%EC%8B%A0%EC%8B%A4%ED%95%9C+%EC%82%AC%EC%A0%9C%EC%9D%98+%EB%B0%B0%EB%8D%95%ED%95%9C+%EC%BB%AC%EB%A0%89%EC%85%98&_rdt_sid=search_instant&_rdt_idx=4&_rdt_arg=%EC%8B%A0%EC%8B%A4%ED%95%9C+%EC%82%AC%EC%A0%9C%EC%9D%98+%EB%B0%B0%EB%8D%95%ED%95%9C+%EC%BB%AC%EB%A0%89%EC%85%98)

“What is the meaning of this, Sister Daphne?”

Daphne, who was regarded as the most devout among the training priestesses.
She had just been caught masturbating by Theodore Valentino—the young cardinal said to be beloved by God Himself.

*‘What… what kind of excuse should I make?’*

She had only wanted to relieve some stress.
What on earth could she say to avoid being branded a libertine who committed such a lewd act right on the temple grounds?

"Right then.I will help you, Sister.”

He whispered to the trembling Daphne.
“What do you mean by…”
“To break the curse of a wicked demon, I am fully prepared to sacrifice this body of mine.”

His massive frame leaned in, casting a heavy shadow over Daphne.

“Let us begin the exorcism.”

Theodore whispered with the face of a devout priest.

The man's low, flowing voice coiled through the narrow storage room like a serpent.
 *Until that very moment, Daphne thought the demon's curse was a problem confined entirely to her alone.*
